svg.title: Synthetic three-bedroom semi-detached location index
svg.desc: Synthetic postcode index points plotted on official ONS December 2024 boundaries for England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland. The floor location is index 100.
svg.metadata: Boundary source: Office for National Statistics, Countries (December 2024) Boundaries UK BGC. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

g.text: Floor location = 100 · synthetic values, not actual postcode assessments
